messages:
Sam: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners, JIRA links, and a 2/6/12 week checkpoint plan for the recurring cache thrash + deploy rollback gaps. Prefer small owners per action.

Alex: I can take the cache-thrash RCA and mitigation. Will create a ticket and attach traces.

Nina: I'll own rollout/runbook work and the canary checklist. Target: 2 weeks for runbook, 6 wks for automation.

Diego: I'll do alerting + dashboard work (draft thresholds + noise suppression).

ops-bot: JIRA created: RINF-3610 "Cache thrash: investigate repeated eviction bursts" assigned to Alex. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-3610

Alex: Subtask RINF-3610-1 created: "collect traces & repro". Tagging Diego for metric correlation.

Diego: I'll spin up a provisional dashboard and a composite alert (eviction-rate + retries). ETA Wed EOD.

Nina: I'll add canary/runbook PR and make RINF-3611 depend on RINF-3610.

Sam: RACI suggestion:
- R: Alex (cache RCA)
- A: Nina (rollout & runbook)
- C: Diego
- I: eng-oncall, product
Agree?

All: Agree.

Sam: Action items summary:
- RINF-3610: cache RCA 1 owner Alex
- RINF-3611: runbook/canary owner Nina (blocked by RINF-3610)
- RINF-3612: alerts/dashboard owner Diego

Alex: Adding trace snippet and initial findings to RINF-3610. Will update by EOD.

Diego: Dashboard link will be posted here when ready.

Nina: I'll calendar the 48h triage and the 2/6/12 week check-ins.

Sam: Thanks team. Keep updates in the tickets; ping me for blockers. Closing thread for now.
